summary: Iteration 3: validated the definitive removeChild fix (PDF import, duplicate + brand-new PDF), dashboard follow-up duplicate-key fix, full PT<->BR i18n switch with revert to PT, and the new Dados da Instituição address field. Backend regression suite extended to 39 tests (all passing) with new coverage for branding address, country switch validation, PDF import create+dedup and cobrador 403. Frontend Playwright runs captured ZERO console errors / pageerrors on all tested flows.

minor.issue: Dedup only guards new imports; the import.teste company still holds legacy duplicates (FT-2026/078 x3, FT-2026/077 x3) created before the dedup existed. No unique index on (company_id, invoice_number), so concurrent imports could still race in duplicates.
Newly seeded demo company doc has no 'address' key (only defaulted at read time). Harmless today, but add address: '' to the seed for consistency.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fired twice on first paint — ResponsiveContainer measures before layout; set minWidth/minHeight or a fixed height on the container to remove the warning

PT uses pre-1990 spelling 'Factura/facturas' (UI shows 'FACTURA', '0 facturas criada(s)'). Post-Acordo Ortográfico PT-PT is 'fatura/faturas'. Since the request asked for a final spelling review, confirm with the user whether 'factura' is intentional; otherwise update DICT.PT invoice keys

rca_of_the_issue: removeChild was caused by refreshing/mutating the charge list while the Radix dialog was unmounting; the fix defers onImported() to the dialog close callback (importedRef) and defensively renders (result.created || []). Duplicate React keys came from two follow-up alerts sharing a charge id; now keyed by id+kind+date. Both fixes verified with console/pageerror listeners capturing zero errors.
